name: Piódão
description: A schist village stacked up one side of a valley in the Serra do Açor, every house the same dark slate, every door and window frame painted blue. It was cut off by road until the 1970s, which is why it still looks like this.
getting: Ninety minutes from Coimbra on mountain roads that take longer than the map says. No bus worth the name. Park at the top and walk down.
